entries.reply: Six documents were reviewed between 2025-03-04 and 2025-09-20. The latest reports flag low HDL Cholesterol of 38 mg/dL, high Fasting Plasma Glucose of 108 mg/dL, and Urine Protein Trace. Trends show falling Total Cholesterol, Triglycerides, LDL Cholesterol, HbA1c, Total PSA, and Haemoglobin based on two reports each. The latest prescription includes Tab. Rosuvas 10 mg, Tab. Ecosprin 75 mg, and Tab. Metformin 500 mg. Diagnoses stated include CAD, post PTCA (2019), and Dyslipidaemia.
